input.value: ExecutionContext created via JsonSchema.createExecutionContext() for a simple object schema {"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}}}

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and ValidationResult.getMessages() is empty
cases.description: Valid JSON node matches the schema; walk should return a successful ValidationResult with no error messages.

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationResult.getMessages() contains a message with keyword 'type'
cases.description: The node provides a string where the schema expects an integer; walk should report a type‑mismatch validation error.

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationResult.getMessages() contains a message with keyword 'required'
cases.description: The required property 'id' is missing; walk should return a ValidationResult indicating the required‑property violation.

input.value: ExecutionContext created for the same schema as in walk_missingRequiredProperty

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == true and ValidationResult.getMessages() is empty
cases.description: When shouldValidateSchema is false the walk should skip validation logic, therefore even an invalid node yields a successful result.

input.value: ExecutionContext created for any valid schema

cases.description: Passing a null JsonNode should cause the method to throw a NullPointerException (guard clause validation).
A null ExecutionContext is not allowed; the method should reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.
The schema contains a $ref that resolves to an internal definition; walk must resolve the reference and validate the node successfully.
Schema uses $dynamicAnchor; walk should treat it like a normal schema and validate the node without errors.

cases.expected: URISyntaxException (or IllegalArgumentException) is thrown due to malformed URI in $ref
cases.description: The schema contains a $ref with an invalid URI syntax; walk should fail while trying to resolve the reference.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) is thrown because the external $ref cannot be retrieved
cases.description: The $ref points to an external resource that does not exist; walk should raise an exception indicating that the reference cannot be resolved.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException (or StackOverflowError) is thrown due to circular $ref resolution
cases.description: The schema contains mutually referencing definitions that create a circular reference; walk should detect the cycle and abort with an exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) is thrown because the schema contains an unsupported keyword
cases.description: The schema includes a keyword that the validator does not recognize; walk should raise an exception indicating the unsupported keyword.

input.value: ExecutionContext created for schema that is a JSON array: [{"type":"string"}]

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException is thrown because the root schema node is not a JSON object
cases.description: The supplied schema is an array rather than an object; walk expects an object schema and should reject this with an IllegalArgumentException.
